name: codex-china-travel-suite
description: China trip planning with AMap, DiDi, Fliggy, Meituan, rail workflows, and iCloud Calendar organization.

interface.shortDescription: Plan China trips, rail connections, and categorized calendars.
interface.longDescription: Combines AMap, DiDi, Fliggy, and Meituan integrations with rail-trip workflows and duplicate-aware iCloud Calendar organization through separately configured official rail and CalDAV connections.
defaultPrompt: Plan a relaxed mainland-China trip and verify every important POI and route with AMap.
Compare relevant Fliggy and Meituan travel products without booking them.
Estimate a DiDi ride, but ask for confirmation before placing or cancelling an order.
Find a feasible train after my appointment and keep pending payment distinct from a paid ticket.
Update my iCloud itinerary, check duplicates, and classify events in my existing calendars.
